captions.instagram:
Class 11 Physics · Work, Energy & Power
Physics, visualised #3 · Where does a swinging pendulum's energy go? ⚖️

Lift a 1 kg bob on a 1.2 m string to 50° and it stores 4.20 J.
🔵 At the top it's all height (potential energy)
🟢 At the bottom it's all speed (kinetic energy)
Without air, they just trade places and the total stays 4.20 J.

Now add air. Each swing hands a little to the air as heat 🟠, and the swing shrinks. That's why every real pendulum stops: the energy isn't lost, it's turned into heat.

On your syllabus: Class 11 Work, Energy & Power and Oscillations.
